title: a mistyped ticket verb files an empty finding: 'prusik feedback list' opened a ticket titled 'list'
detail: The positional is a title OR a verb. Any word outside _TICKET_VERBS (list, ls, close, status, help) is taken as a title and filed with empty detail, rc=0, and rides the next export to HQ. Hit 2026-11-11 while trying to list findings. A one-word title with no --detail or --repro says nothing and should be refused with rc!=0, naming --list and the verbs. Same sprint corrects stale README claims: field record says 43/43 zero open (live: 74 filed, 67 closed, 7 open), 98 pinned findings (live: 122), 1,900+ tests (live: 2,894), and the Action example pins @main.
